name: agentic-self-hosting
goal: Harness hosts itself: component contracts, dual-graph impact, scenario evidence, frozen budgets, Git-native notes and evidence history, and a protected prebuilt /harness console are proven by failing-then-passing acceptance tests

title: Stage A - contracts, registry, unit scaffold and source graph: acceptance tests fail on unchanged behavior, then pass unchanged.
Stage B - module, Wasm, native-process and HTTP runtimes with Rust kernel parity and measured default: red then green.
Stage C - scenario contracts, verification, budgets and reasons: red then green.
Stage D - Git notes, LFS evidence branch, sync, hooks and CI: red then green.
Stage E - reused /harness console, protected endpoints and SvelteKit installer: before screenshots, red, then green screenshots at 1440, 920 and 390.
Stage F - self-host registry, fixtures, migration, packaging, full checks and acceptance.

title: Stage B repairs from independent review: elapsed deadlines, one portable JSON contract, the stated coverage rule and calibration provenance.

evidence: RED work/logs/stage-b2-red.log on the then-current code: 11 tests failed in 6 files and cargo test failed. The synchronous deadline probe returned success after its 5 ms deadline; the reference accepted 1e400, lone surrogates and 65-level nesting; the Rust typed path accepted an out-of-range number in an ignored field; benchmark runs carried no calibration label. GREEN work/logs/stage-b-green.log: 14 Stage B files, 46 tests. The four new test files are unchanged since red; vectors grew 26 to 38 before red and to 39 after, with every earlier vector unchanged (work/logs/stage-b-test-diff.log). Full bun run check EXIT=0 (work/logs/stage-b-check.log): cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, cargo test 2 passed on 39 shared vectors; 304 unit, 73 CLI E2E, 2 package, 88 reports tests; both audits; units check 368 units, 6 uncertain. harness kernel parity 150 cases including 19 raw edge texts, 0 mismatches for wasm and process (work/logs/stage-b-parity.json). The stronger parity command found that the persistent native process did not answer a blank line; fixed and pinned by a vector. The first portability check cost 2.84 ms per pass at 10k nodes and doubled module latency; rewritten to 0.285 ms and run once on the module path. Recorded benchmark is calibration from an uncommitted tree: verified false, no tested revision, artifact and source hashes kept. In-process deadlines reject late results but cannot interrupt work; hard limits need process isolation in the Stage C verifier.

title: Stage C repairs from independent review: a proven base instead of a trusted range, a complete comparison context for performance, and a snapshot that stays the exact commit.

evidence: Three confirmed black-box findings from Codex, each reproduced through the CLI before repair. (1) Range narrowing: verify --base HEAD, an empty child and an unverified parent let unapproved growth, a missing reason and a failing test pass. RED work/logs/stage-c4-red.log: verify-range 4 of 5 failed. Repair: everything is judged from the nearest revision that a passing, intact record proves, or from nothing; reasons chain across commits; records name the base used and the base requested. (2) Comparability: a measurement in seconds against a baseline in ms, and a cheaper request or fewer samples under the same workload name, passed. RED stage-c4-red.log: budget-comparability 4 of 4 failed, the typed API test file could not load and the packed consumer failed its type check. Repair: a baseline freezes unit, method and a comparison context (request hash, boundary, protocol, sampling); only identical definitions compare, differences are incompatible, missing metadata is incomplete, a new definition needs a reviewed approval and the ledger keeps the earlier one. The exact 5 percent rule and the real slowed-operation proof are unchanged. (3) Snapshot integrity: a check that created src/utils/untracked-generated.ts passed. RED work/logs/stage-c5-red.log: verify-snapshot 5 of 5 failed. Repair: the export is compared with the commit after setup and after every check; changed, removed or renamed tracked files and any file outside a declared output fail, and an output that covers tracked files is refused. One comparison costs 11 ms on the 1,021 tracked files of Harness. Copies of Codex's probes, with outputs redirected to work/probes, now reject all of their cases. GREEN and full check as recorded on step stage-c.

RED on the unchanged Stage C commit 143e486: work/logs/stage-d-red.log, 13 new test files failed (22 tests failed, 4 skipped by failed setup, 5 files could not load). Independent finding from Codex reproduced before repair in work/logs/stage-d2-red.log: two records with identical media attached at once in one repository lost a record (3 of 4 tests failed). Reasons persistence red in stage-d3-red.log (2 of 2). GREEN work/logs/stage-d-green.log: 31 Stage D and Stage C files, 97 tests. Test provenance with every post-red change and exact diffs: work/logs/stage-d-test-diff.log. Full bun run check EXIT=0 with the tree digest unchanged during it (work/logs/stage-d-check.log): cargo fmt, clippy and cargo test; 358 unit tests in 107 files with 25 live-API tests in 2 files skipped; 144 CLI end-to-end tests in 43 files; 4 packed-package tests including the history entry; both audits; units check 456 units with 6 uncertain; 88 reports tests. Codex's unmodified probe work/root-build-stage-d-probe.ts exits 0 on the final code: three concurrent-attach attempts keep both records, a changed request under one workload name is an incompatible series in the index, and a failed record with a forged passing note stays unverified. The overlapping-writer suite passed three further runs. harness explain check: 72 reasons for 56 units, listed in work/logs/stage-d-rationale.md; the Stage C range ab9d6a2..143e486 still checks as 72 reasons. Not done here: nothing was attached, imported, synchronised or installed in the Harness repository itself (no history refs and no hook exist there), the CI workflows have not run on a hosted runner, and Harness still has no verified commit or baseline.
